scope: Recall-oriented approval proposals; synthetic local validation, no deployment.

baseline.observation: The previous normalization contract discarded an ambiguous company/vendor create. The revised fixture produces an explicit low-confidence company update interpretation without merging aliases. This is a deterministic persistence regression comparison, not a paired live-model benchmark.

hard_boundaries: No invented owners, deadlines or completion

live_evaluation.positive: Tentative access-checklist request with no chosen assignee or deadline
live_evaluation.usage: Provider costs were not separately aggregated for this follow-up run.

discovered_bug: Background replay of a rejected proposal attempted to insert a synthetic worker ID into resolved_by_user_id. Suppressed projections now preserve existing reviewer attribution or leave it null; original rejection records remain intact. Forced reinference of unchanged evidence passes without re-offering the rejected proposal.
limitations: Two unique new synthetic live cases do not establish population recall or precision.
No paired live comparison against the full previous revision on representative customer events.
Rejections persist for reviewed labeling; this change does not train models automatically.
Railway operational and real-event validation remain unavailable.
